title: Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for one transformation

issues.description: The sated-extension construction takes a supremum 'over all extensions of the current stage'. As written, that ranges over a class that is not explicitly a set. This is standard and can be fixed by restricting to extensions realised on a fixed standard Borel space. It does not affect the mathematics, but it is not addressed.
issues.evidence: For each pair choose an extension whose projection norm is within 2^{-q} of the supremum over extensions of the current stage.

issues.location: sec 5, Prop. measurable-labels and Lemma finite-blocks (05-labels-blocks.tex)
issues.description: Several measurable-selection and conull-set steps are only sketched: the disintegration giving an admissible square completion for a.e. (p,q) pair, the Fubini choice of u_* and of the reference fibre u_0, and the measurable spectral enumeration with random weights. I found no error, but I did not verify these steps to full rigour.
issues.evidence: Disintegrate this set over the two tuples meeting at (i,i)... Each such pair has an admissible completion.
